class Stats:
    @staticmethod
    def average_transaction(ledger: Ledger, category: str) -> float:
        entries: List[Entry] = [entry for entry in ledger.entries if entry.category == category]

from ledger.store import Ledger, Entry

def average_transaction(ledger: Ledger, category: str) -> float:
    entries_in_category = [entry for entry in ledger.entries if entry.category == category]
    
    if not entries_in_category:

    total_cents = sum(entry.cents for entry in entries_in_category)

def over_budget(ledger: Ledger, limits: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, int]:
    category_spending = {}
    
    for entry in ledger.entries:
        if entry.cents < 0:
            if entry.category in category_spending:
                category_spending[entry.category] += -entry.cents
            else:
                category_spending[entry.category] = -entry.cents
    
    over_budget_result = {}
    for category, spending in category_spending.items():
        if category in limits and spending > limits[category]:
